[광역 피해] Pop Blur for the Ravenous Stomp party damage, where the group uses defensives (Topicx)
[참고] Line up damage cooldowns with every Ssscavenging shield. On a shield without Metamorphosis (2 min), use The Hunt (1 min 30 sec) and Essence Break (Topicx)

[회피] Clear the Toxic Atrophy movement slow with Vengeful Retreat (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Use Metamorphosis and The Hunt in the Uncoil split (Bloodlust), and stun the gathered Writhes with Chaos Nova so they cannot reach their Spiteful Hunt target (Topicx)
Zul'jan: [위치] If you soak a Ritual of the Fang beam, Fel Rush back to the same spot before the channel every time (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Pop Blur (10 sec) during the 8 sec channel while you block a beam with your body (Topicx)

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt does not need a kick rotation. Kick it with Disrupt when it is available (Topicx)

[위치] When you step into Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam, pop Blur to take the patch's Nature damage (77586 per sec) and the beam's Holy damage, then clear the 50% slow with Vengeful Retreat to leave when the beam ends
[광역 피해] When the three bosses are stacked, Immolation Aura and Blade Dance hit all three, so use Metamorphosis then
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [회피] If you are the Bloodthirsty Gaze target, gain distance with Fel Rush and Vengeful Retreat
[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Thorncaller Roar, and save Darkness for the Lightcrazed Frenzy phase after 50%
[참고] Bloodlust goes out below 50% when no Bloodthirsty Gaze chase is active, so line up Metamorphosis and The Hunt with it (Topicx)
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Disrupt in the kick rotation for Moonkin Form Warden's Wrath
[광역 피해] If you are marked by Pulverizing Strikes, do not move with Fel Rush or Vengeful Retreat; stand still and take the 6 sec Physical cone (164870 every 2 sec) with Blur
[광역 피해] Save Darkness and Blur for Spirits of the Vale after 40%
Ziekket: [차단] Kick Lightspore Shot from Lashers before they revive with Disrupt, and if several are grouped, stun them together with Chaos Nova
[회피] Clear the Spore Spines slow from Lasher melee attacks with Vengeful Retreat (Wowhead)
[위치] Do not Vengeful Retreat backward near the right edge of the platform. Backing all the way to the edge pulls the Overgrown Hydra (Topicx)

The Hoardmonger: [광역 피해] For the raid-wide Ravenous Bellow damage, pop Blur or time a Blade Dance for the Deflecting Dance absorb
[회피] Clear the movement slow from Bonespike Slam spike puddles with Vengeful Retreat
[위치] Loop quickly through Spoiled Supplies mushrooms with Fel Rush
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Disrupt in the Winter's Shroud kick rotation. A successful kick gives Demon Muzzle, reducing magic damage taken by 15% for 12 sec, so take the kick right before Frozen Tempest
[위치] As a melee, take the Fractured Shivercore next to the boss. Both adds must die at the same time, so do not dump The Hunt and Essence Break on one add and kill it early (Topicx)

Nalorakk: [위치] If you are an Echoing Maul target, Fel Rush within 4 sec to this set's corner. Place Echoes in a different corner each set to spread them evenly around the room (Topicx)
[광역 피해] As an Echoing Maul target, pop Blur for the Nature damage when the Echo lands (Topicx)
[광역 피해] While you body-block Echoes during Fury of the War God, line up Blade Dance and take it with Deflecting Dance if Blur is down, and use Darkness if many players are blocking

Kystia Manaheart: [차단] Kick one Mirror Images clone's Felstorm with Disrupt, and control the rest with Chaos Nova or Sigil of Misery

Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] The fight starts with the worker pack after the RP, and the second Bloodlust goes out here. Use Metamorphosis and The Hunt now, and kill Keen Taskmaster first to stop the Back to Work! enrage (Topicx)

Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Disrupt in the Chaos Bolt kick rotation
[제어] When a Wild Imp pack casts Felfire Burst, stun them all with Chaos Nova
[참고] Spend damage cooldowns on the adds, not the boss. When Furious Vilefiend or Wild Imps spawn, put Metamorphosis and The Hunt into them (Topicx)

Mchimba the Embalmer: [광역 피해] Bloodlust goes on Mchimba (Topicx), so line up Metamorphosis and The Hunt with it

[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Awakening Slam

183752.d: 적의 주문 시전을 방해하고 5초 동안 해당 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하게 차단합니다. [방해의 격노: 차단에 성공하면 30의 격노가 생성됩니다]

185123.m: 격노 25 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 9 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
185123.d: 대상에게 악마의 글레이브를 투척하여 (전투력의 49.2352%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 이후 글레이브는 10미터 내의 적에게 [튀어오르는 글레이브: 1회 추가로회 추가로] 튕깁니다.

188499.d: 주위 적을 공격하여 [3 * (전투력의 24.75%)% + (전투력의 74.2%)%]의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 대상이 5명을 초과하면 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

188501.d:
은신 및 투명 상태의 적과, 물리적 장애물 너머의 적과 보물을 볼 수 있습니다. 8초 동안 지속됩니다.

제어 불가 효과에 걸리면 시야가 해제됩니다.

191427.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
191427.d:
공중으로 도약하여 폭발적인 힘으로 착지하며 주위 8미터 내의 적에게 (전투력의 44%)의 혼돈 피해를 입히고 3초 동안 기절시킵니다. 대신 플레이어는 3초 동안 멍해집니다.

착지 시 20초 동안 지옥의 악마로 변신하여, [탈태: 즉시 안광과 칼춤의 능력의 재사용 대기시간이 초기화되고]혼돈의 일격과 칼춤 능력이 크게 강화되고 가속이 20%만큼 증가합니다..

195072.m: 즉시 · 10 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
195072.d: 전방으로 돌진하며 이동 경로상의 모든 것을 불태워 (전투력의 43.4673%)의 혼돈 피해를 입힙니다.

196718.d:
자신의 주위 8미터 반경 내에 어둠을 소환하여 아군 대상이 15%의 확률로 모든 피해를 회피할 수 있게 합니다. 8초 동안 지속됩니다.

공격대에 속해 있지 않을 때는 피해를 회피할 확률이 100%만큼 증가합니다.

198013.m: 특성 · 격노 30 · 20 야드 사정거리 · 집중 (2 초 주문 시전 시간) · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
198013.d: 2초에 걸쳐 전방의 모든 적에게 [치명적인 시선: 극대화 효과로]최대 [(전투력의 40.26%) * 10]의 혼돈 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다. [격노의 응시: 안광 시전을 끝까지 마치면 8초 동안 가속이 추가로 8%만큼 증가합니다]

198589.m: 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능

198793.m: 특성 · 즉시 · 25 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
198793.d: 모든 감속 효과를 제거하고 도약하여 멀어집니다. 주위의 적은 (전투력의 16%)의 물리 피해를 입 [복수의 유대: 고 3초 동안 이동 속도가 70%만큼 감소합니다 / 습니다].

201427.d: 대상을 베어 [(전투력의 95.67%) + (전투력의 150.34%)]의 혼돈 피해를 입힙니다. 파멸 시전 시 20%의 확률로 20의 격노를 돌려받습니다.

203796.d: 자동 공격이 (전투력의 46.4%)의 추가 암흑 피해를 입히고 1016의 격노를 생성합니다.

204909.d:
생기흡수가 6%만큼 증가합니다.

탈태가 활성화되어 있는 동안 생기흡수가 추가로 6%만큼 증가합니다.

205411.d:
흐릿해지기가 추가로 받는 피해를 10%만큼 감소시킵니다.

또한 생명력이 35% 미만일 때 받는 피해가 10%만큼 감소합니다.

206476.d: 사냥, 복수의 퇴각이 20초 동안 공격력을 5%만큼 증가시킵니다. (400밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

207684.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
207684.d:
대상 위치에 불행의 인장을 생성하고 2초 후 활성화시킵니다.

인장의 영향을 받는 모든 적은 공포에 질려 제자리에서 떨게 되며, 15초 동안 방향 감각을 상실합니다.

210152.d: 주위 적 5명을 공격하여 [3 * (전투력의 32.18%)% + (전투력의 96.46%)%]의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 대상이 5명을 초과하면 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

213410.d: 안광의 공격이 끝난 후 5초 동안 악마 형상이 됩니다.

217832.m: 특성 · 20 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
217832.d: 1분 동안 악마, 야수, 인간형 대상을 감금하여 행동 불가 상태로 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 입으면 효과가 해제될 수 있습니다. 대상은 하나로 제한됩니다.

232893.m: 특성 · 15 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 12 초 재사용 대기시간
232893.d:
대상에게 돌진하여 (전투력의 122.94%)%의 화염 피해를 입힙니다.

15의 격노를 생성합니다.

255260.d: 피해를 준 대상에 낙인을 찍어, 대상이 받는 마법 피해를 3%만큼 증가시킵니다.

258860.m: 특성 · 10 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 40 초 재사용 대기시간
258860.d: 전방의 모든 적을 베어 (전투력의 462%)의 혼돈 피해를 입히고, 혼돈의 일격과 칼춤이 대상에게 4초 동안 (전투력의 257.4%)의 혼돈 피해를 입히도록 합니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

258887.d: 안광 활성화 시 다음 안광의 재사용 대기시간이 2.5초만큼 감소합니다. 최대 10초까지 중첩됩니다.

258920.m: 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
258920.d:
자신의 몸을 불길로 뒤덮어 열기를 내뿜어 1초마다 [(전투력의 12.466%) * 6]의 화염 피해를 입힙니다. 6초 동안 지속됩니다.

20의 격노를 생성합니다.

278326.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 10 초 재사용 대기시간
278326.d: 대상의 이로운 마법 효과 1개를 흡수하여 제거합니다. [삼켜진 분노: 추가로 20의 격노를 생성합니다]

370965.m: 특성 · 50 야드 사정거리 · 1 초 주문 시전 시간 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
370965.d: 대상에게 돌진하여 (전투력의 744.24%)의 혼돈 피해를 입히고 1.5초 동안 이동 불가 상태로 만들며, 돌진 경로에 있는 최대 5명의 적에게 6초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 480.6%)의 혼돈 피해를 입힙니다.

388107.d:
제물의 오라가 피해를 입힐 때마다, 최대 3회의 극대화 피해로 입힌 피해의 35%를 성난불길로 축적합니다.

제물의 오라가 만료되면 폭발을 일으켜 주위 적에게 저장된 모든 성난불길 피해를 입힙니다.

388108.d:
적에게 피해를 받기 전에 먼저 피해를 입히면 5초 동안 치명타 및 극대화율이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

복수의 퇴각 사용 시 전투 중인 적에게 이 효과가 다시 발동할 수 있게 됩니다.

388112.d: 탈태를 활성화하면 칼춤 및 안광의 재사용 대기시간이 즉시 초기화됩니다.

389688.d: 복수의 퇴각의 재사용 대기시간이 5초만큼 감소하고 10초에 걸쳐 80의 격노를 생성합니다.

391189.d:
[악마 칼날 / 악마의 이빨] 및 글레이브 투척이 적에게 열린 상처를 남겨 15초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 73.45%)의 혼돈 피해를 입히고 자신의 제물의 오라로 받는 피해를 35%만큼 증가시킵니다.

최대 3명의 대상에게 유효합니다.

427775.d:
제물의 오라가 추가로 1회 충전되고 재사용 대기시간이 6초만큼 감소합니다. 또한 화염 피해가 아닌 혼돈 피해를 입힙니다.

제물의 오라를 동시에 중첩하여 활성화할 수 있습니다.

427776.d: 칼춤이 활성화된 동안 받는 공격을 튕겨내, 최대 생명력의 최대 15%에 해당하는 피해를 흡수합니다.

442290.d:
영혼 파편 6개를 흡수하거나 사냥을 시전하면 다음 글레이브 투척이 파괴자의 글레이브로 전환됩니다.

파괴자의 글레이브:
흡수한 영혼의 정수로 강화된 전투검을 대상에게 던져 (전투력의 481%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 2명의 추가 적에게 튕겨 피해를 입힙니다.

이후 철저하게 연마한 전투검술을 구사하여 다음 혼돈의 일격 및 칼춤을 강화합니다.

처음으로 시전하는 강화된 능력은 15%의 추가 피해를 입히며, 두 번째 능력은 30%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

442294.d:
흡수한 영혼의 정수로 강화된 전투검을 대상에게 던져 (전투력의 481%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 2명의 추가 적에게 튕겨 피해를 입힙니다.

이후 철저하게 연마한 전투검술을 구사하여 다음 혼돈의 일격 및 칼춤을 강화합니다.

처음으로 시전하는 강화된 능력은 15%의 추가 피해를 입히며, 두 번째 능력은 30%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

442502.d:
영혼 파편을 흡수하면 다음 혼돈의 일격 사용 시 (전투력의 62%)의 추가 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

지옥칼은 주위에 있는 최대 5개의 영혼 파편을 흡수합니다.

442679.d:
파괴자의 글레이브로 강화되면 혼돈의 일격 사용 시 파괴자의 징표를 부여해 20초 동안 대상이 받는 피해를 8%만큼 증가시킵니다. 최대 2번까지 중첩됩니다.

칼춤을 사용한 후에 파괴자의 징표 1중첩을 추가로 부여합니다.

442686.d: 두 강화 효과를 모두 소모하면 전투의 전율이 부여되어 다음 파괴자의 글레이브의 공격력이 30%만큼 증가하고, 30초 동안 가속이 8%만큼 증가합니다.

442718.d:
파괴자의 글레이브로 강화 시 칼춤을 시전하면 주위의 대상에게 3번 글레이브 베기를 날립니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

혼돈의 일격 이후에 시전할 경우 베기를 6번 날립니다.

442806.d: 파괴자의 징표가 대상의 약점을 노출시켜, 적에게 물리 피해를 입히면 징표가 남은 대상에게 입힌 피해의 30%에 해당하는 혼돈 피해를 추가로 입힙니다. 추가로 일정 확률로 영혼 파편을 생성합니다.

452402.d:
탈태 활성화 시 추가로 악마 칼날이 3의 격노를 생성합니다.

악마 형상이 활성화된 동안 각 강화된 능력을 처음으로 시전하면 악마쇄도가 발동하여 지옥 마력을 방출해 주위의 적에게 (전투력의 280%)의 혼돈 피해를 입힙니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

452409.d: 탈태 활성화 시 제물의 오라의 재사용 대기시간이 초기화됩니다.

452413.d: 제물의 오라의 반경이 2미터만큼, 치명타 및 극대화 피해 증가량이 50%만큼 증가합니다.

452415.d:
탈태 활성화 시 안광과 제물의 오라가 크게 강화됩니다.

악마 형상이 활성화된 동안 발동한 악마쇄도 횟수만큼 그 공격력이 5%만큼 증가합니다.

452487.m: 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
452487.d:
자신의 몸을 불길로 뒤덮어 열기를 내뿜어 1초마다 [(전투력의 12.466%) * 6]의 화염 피해를 입힙니다. 6초 동안 지속됩니다.

20의 격노를 생성합니다.

452497.m: 격노 30 · 20 야드 사정거리 · 집중 (2 초 주문 시전 시간) · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
452497.d: 2초에 걸쳐 전방의 모든 적에게 [치명적인 시선: 극대화 효과로] 최대 [(전투력의 40.26%) * 10]의 혼돈 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다. [격노의 응시: 안광 시전을 끝까지 마치면 8초 동안 가속이 추가로 8%만큼 증가합니다]

1220506.d: 칼춤 사용 시 자동으로 주 대상에게 글레이브 투척을 시전하여 100%의 피해를 입힙니다. 또한 칼춤으로 공격할 때마다 50%의 확률로 적에게 글레이브 투척을 시전해 35%의 피해를 입힙니다.

1238084.d:
덩굴손은 근접 공격 시 대상에게 꽃가루를 남겨 2초마다 1의 자연 피해를 입히고 16초 동안 이동 속도를 2%만큼 감소시킵니다.

이 효과는 중첩됩니다.

1244557.d: 칼춤의 마지막 베기가 3명 이상의 적에게 적중할 때 25의 격노를 소모하여, 악마의 글레이브 한 쌍을 던져 막강한 소용돌이를 만듭니다. 소용돌이는 주위의 모든 적에게 3초에 걸쳐 [14 * (전투력의 13.2%)]의 혼돈 피해를 입힙니다. 대상이 8명을 초과하면 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

1266329.d: 분열로 주문을 방해하면 12초 동안 받는 마법 피해가 15%만큼 감소합니다.

1270901.d:
칼춤의 공격력이 20%만큼 증가합니다.

안광의 시전을 끝까지 마치면 다음 칼춤 사용 시 재사용 대기시간이 초기화됩니다.

1272153.d:
혼돈의 일격 사용 후 칼춤을 시전하면 알드라치의 격노에 의해 추가로 강화되어, 베기 횟수가 12번으로 증가합니다.

파괴자의 징표가 최대 2번까지 중첩되며, 칼춤 사용 후 혼돈의 일격 시전 시 효과가 추가로 강화되어 추가 중첩을 부여합니다.

1: [차단] Put Disrupt (15 sec) in the kick rotation for Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy) so it keeps walking to the tank. A successful kick also gives Demon Muzzle, reducing magic damage taken by 15% for 12 sec.

[제어] When a Spellsower runs to a dormant Lasher pack with Call The Grove, follow it with Felblade (12 sec) and stop Frantic Blooming with Chaos Nova (45 sec, 3 sec stun). If it is already far away, drop Sigil of Misery (2 min, 30 yd, 15 sec disorient after 2 sec) on its spot.

[광역 피해] Once everything is stacked and Bloodlust goes out, use Metamorphosis (2 min) and The Hunt (1 min 30 sec) together. Pop Blur (1 min, 35% damage reduction with Desperate Instincts) for the following Spouting Floret from Sporeblight Belcher (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec).
2: [차단] Kick one Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley with Disrupt, and if both are stacked on the tank, stun them together with Chaos Nova to stop the other cast.
[광역 피해] If Blur (1 min) from pull 1 is not back, press Blade Dance as Spouting Floret starts to absorb up to 15% of your max health with Deflecting Dance.

[우선 처치] A Lightgorged Lasher under its Lightbloom Pollination shield (600108 absorb) is immune to crowd control. Save stuns for the Spellsowers and put single-target damage into that Lasher until the shield breaks (Method).
3: [제어] When a Radiant Spellsower runs toward the 12 Lashers, stop Frantic Blooming. If Chaos Nova (45 sec) was used on pull 2, hold it with Sigil of Misery.

[회피] If Virid Grovekeeper's Uproot (3 sec cast, 116379 Nature and a knockback) pushes you away, get straight back into melee with Fel Rush (10 sec) or Felblade, and clear the 40% slow from the Earthrupture Strike patch with Vengeful Retreat (20 sec with Tactical Retreat).
[광역 피해] If The Hunt (1 min 30 sec) is back, charge through the 12 stacked Lashers so the damage over time hits up to 5 enemies in your path.
5: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast, 3 sec party disorient) with Disrupt.
[제어] When Thorny Saptor jumps on a party member with Thornclaw Leap, break the cone follow-up (145474 Physical) with Chaos Nova or Sigil of Misery (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Spouting Floret from the Sporeblight Belcher pulled first. If Metamorphosis (2 min) from pull 1 is back, use it after the Virid Grovekeeper joins 5-6 sec later.
7: [제어] Stop Thornclaw Leap from both Thorny Saptors with Chaos Nova once they are grouped, and cover a Saptor that jumps separately with Sigil of Misery (Wowhead).
[차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Disrupt. If Disrupt is still available, kick Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot too.
[참고] While the 5 Spineshield Beetles keep Spiny Shield (500090 absorb), every Blade Dance and Immolation Aura hit returns 4849 Nature to you. Pop Blur while breaking the shields.
8: [제어] Stop the 2 Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with Chaos Nova and Sigil of Misery. If Sigil of Misery (2 min) from pull 7 is not back, hold Chaos Nova until both are grouped.
[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret. If Blur was used on pull 7 less than 1 min ago, line up Blade Dance with the start of Spouting Floret and take it with Deflecting Dance.
[차단] Kick Seed Shot (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature) from the 2 Leafy Grovecrawlers with Disrupt when it is free.
10: [위치] Potatoad Matriarch is pulled as soon as someone crosses a certain spot on the floor, so do not Fel Rush or Metamorphosis leap (40 yd) past it while clearing the adds.
[광역 피해] Havoc cannot dispel Toxic Spew (2 sec cast, 67888 Nature and a 9 sec poison), so pop Blur when you see the cast.
[우선 처치] When Potadpole Eggs appear, turn Eye Beam (2 sec frontal channel) and Blade Dance onto the eggs to break them fast.
11: [차단] Kick one Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Disrupt, and if all 3 are grouped, stun the rest together with Chaos Nova.
[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret. If Blur (1 min) used on pull 10's Toxic Spew is not back, line up Blade Dance and take it with Deflecting Dance.
12: [우선 처치] When the 6 Lightgorged Lashers put up Lightbloom Pollination shields (600108 absorb), nearby mobs gain 50% attack speed. This is the last big pull before Ziekket, so line up Metamorphosis and The Hunt here and break the shields together (Method).
[차단] Split Light Bolt Volley from the 2 Radiant Spellsowers between Disrupt and Chaos Nova. The Metamorphosis landing also stuns enemies within 8 yd for 3 sec, so land on a casting Spellsower.
[제어] Shielded Lashers are immune to crowd control, so save Chaos Nova and Sigil of Misery for the Spellsowers' Call The Grove.

1: [차단] Kick one of the 2 Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical and 30% haste reduction) with Disrupt (15 sec). A successful kick also gives Demon Muzzle, reducing magic damage taken by 15% for 12 sec.
[제어] When the Ravenous Claws attack speed stacks on the 7 Ravenous Descendants start hurting the tank, stun them with Chaos Nova (45 sec, 3 sec stun) to reset the stacks (Wowhead).

[회피] If you get Paralyzing Shots from Twinfang Harrower (48491 Nature every sec for 20 sec, 10% slow per tick), clear it with Vengeful Retreat (20 sec with Tactical Retreat). On this pull, keep Vengeful Retreat out of your damage rotation and save it for this (Wowhead).
2: [우선 처치] Charge Ritual Chieftain with The Hunt (1 min 30 sec) and burn it first. Unstable Totem and Blood Sacrifice keep coming while the Chieftain is alive.

[광역 피해] When Blood Sacrifice lands (87284 Physical and a 162029 heal absorb), pop Blur (1 min) and delay Eye Beam until right after it, so the extra Soul Rending leech from Demonic demon form clears the heal absorb fast (Wowhead).
[차단] Kick Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Disrupt.
3: [차단] Kick one of the 3 Primal Serpents that walk down past the pillar with Disrupt, and if all three are grouped, stun them together with Chaos Nova to stop the other Piercing Hiss casts.

[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Ritual Chieftain's Blood Sacrifice and line up Eye Beam so Soul Rending leech clears the heal absorb. If Blur (1 min) from pull 2 is not back, line up Blade Dance and absorb up to 15% of your max health with Deflecting Dance.
4: [제어] When the 4 Ravenous Descendants stack attack speed, break it with Chaos Nova. If Chaos Nova was used on pull 3, cover one Primal Serpent's kick with Disrupt alone.
[위치] Do not Fel Rush or Metamorphosis leap (40 yd) in ahead until the 2 Ravenous Descendants walk away from the Twinfang Harrower, or the Harrower comes too.
5: [광역 피해] This is the largest trash pull of the route (103). Line up Metamorphosis (2 min) and The Hunt here, and charge Ritual Chieftain with The Hunt.
[회피] Clear Paralyzing Shots from the 2 Twinfang Harrowers with Vengeful Retreat. Keep Vengeful Retreat out of your rotation for the second Paralyzing Shots (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] Pop Blur when Blood Sacrifice and the Paralyzing Shots dot overlap. Side-step the Toxic Breath frontal (3 sec cast, 67888 Nature every 0.5 sec) with Fel Rush.
7: [차단] Always kick High Evolutionist's Envenom cast with Disrupt right before Rattling Writhe casts Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every sec for 5 sec) (Topicx).
[제어] The 3 Bloodletters leave a blood pool on every melee swing, so stun them with Chaos Nova or hold them with Sigil of Misery (2 min, 15 sec disorient).
[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Rattle. If High Evolutionist starts Evolve (6 sec channel) while Disrupt is down, break it with Chaos Nova or the 3 sec stun from the Metamorphosis landing.
8: [제어] Hold the 4 Bloodletters with Sigil of Misery or Chaos Nova so blood pools do not pile up under the tank.
[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Rattling Writhe's Rattle. If Blur (1 min) from pull 7 is not back, line up Blade Dance and take it with Deflecting Dance.
9: [차단] Take the High Evolutionist next to the tank with Disrupt. A ranged player covers the far-left Evolutionist, so do not leave melee range (Topicx).
[제어] Break the Evolve channel with Chaos Nova. When the channel finishes, the caster gains a shield (250045 absorb) and crowd control immunity.
11: [차단] Kick Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast) from your assigned High Evolutionist next to the totem with Disrupt (Topicx).

[제어] Break Evolve channels on several Evolutionists together with Chaos Nova, and if Chaos Nova is down, land Metamorphosis on the channeling Evolutionist for a 3 sec stun. Hold the remaining casters with Sigil of Misery.
12: [위치] During Ascendant Serpent's Infest everyone has to stand on the tank's marked spot, so do not Vengeful Retreat backward or Fel Rush away from it (Topicx).
[우선 처치] It has to die before the third Infest, so put The Hunt and Essence Break (40 sec) into the Serpent. If Metamorphosis is back, use it too.
13: [차단] Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom must be kicked every time. Use Disrupt on the Chosen and alternate with another kicker while it is on cooldown.

[참고] If the 6 Living Venoms die at once, the Venom Burst explosions stack and endanger the group. Do not use Metamorphosis or Eye Beam on this pull, and put single-target Chaos Strike damage into the Chosen (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec) and dodge the Toxic Beam lines with Fel Rush. Stun Blade of the Altar with Chaos Nova during it.
14: [차단] Kick Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom with Disrupt. It is pulled right after pull 13, so keep the same kick order.
[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Toxic Surge. If Blur (1 min) from pull 13 is not back, line up Blade Dance and take it with Deflecting Dance.
[제어] Hold the 2 Blades of the Altar with Chaos Nova during Toxic Surge to stop the Laced Edge teleport attacks (Topicx).
15: [회피] Clear Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots with Vengeful Retreat (Wowhead).
[차단] Kick one of the 2 Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Disrupt.
[제어] When the 4 Blades of the Altar are grouped, stun them together with Chaos Nova.
16: [우선 처치] Charge Ula'tek's Chosen with The Hunt and use Metamorphosis with it so it dies before the second Toxic Surge (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Blood Sacrifice from the 2 Ritual Chieftains comes back to back and overlaps with Toxic Surge, so pop Blur and use Eye Beam right after Blood Sacrifice so Soul Rending leech clears the heal absorb (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] This pull puts the most pressure on the healer. If you saved Darkness (5 min), drop it in the middle of the group when Blood Sacrifice and Toxic Surge overlap.

1: [광역 피해] This pull takes Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together under Bloodlust (Topicx). Pop Metamorphosis (2 min) and charge the Captain with The Hunt (1 min 30 sec) to kill it first.

[우선 처치] The Captain's Deep Corruption aura raises nearby mobs' damage by 25% and cuts their AoE damage taken by 25%, so put Essence Break (40 sec) and single-target damage into the Captain before moving to the Guard.
[광역 피해] Pop Blur (1 min) when Row Hooligan's Cutpurse (38793 Physical and a 155172 bleed over 8 sec) overlaps with Street Sneak's Heartstop Poison. Havoc cannot dispel the poison.
2: [차단] Each Seductive Sayaad's Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) gets its own kicker (Topicx). Take one with Disrupt (15 sec), and if the other kicker misses, stop it with Chaos Nova (45 sec, 3 sec stun).
[회피] Felwyrms explode with Fel Detonation (193965 Fire) within 4 yd on death. Vengeful Retreat backward right before your AoE finishes them.
3: [회피] If the 6 Felwyrms die together in melee, the Fel Detonations stack. Vengeful Retreat out of 4 yd at the end, and pop Blur if you cannot get out.
[차단] Kick Felonious Mage's Fel Missiles channel with Disrupt when it is free.
4: [제어] Heartstop Poison from the 4 Street Sneaks cuts max health by 5% per hit and endangers the tank. Stun them with Chaos Nova while their weapons are coated to cut the number of hits.
[차단] Kick Felonious Mage's Fel Missiles with Disrupt.
5: [우선 처치] Kill Massive Felwyrm first (Topicx). Charge it with The Hunt and use Essence Break.
[광역 피해] While Massive Felwyrm is alive, Over-infused triggers Burning Fel (38793 Fire) every 3 sec, so pop Blur.
[회피] When Massive Felwyrm dies, Massive Fel Detonation (290947 Fire, 10 yd) goes off after 5 sec. Leave 10 yd with Fel Rush or Vengeful Retreat.
8: [차단] Kick Health Funnel from the 2 Fel Invokers with Disrupt, and if Disrupt is free, also kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, 60% damage reduction and crowd control immunity).
[회피] When Shivan Punisher casts Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 290947 Physical within 12 yd), Vengeful Retreat out of 12 yd and come back with Felblade (12 sec).
[우선 처치] When the Punisher drops below 50% and starts Demonic Frenzy (29095 Fire every sec), finish it right away with The Hunt and Essence Break (Topicx).
9: [광역 피해] Pop Blur if you are the Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life target. Without a defensive, the warlock heals a lot (Topicx).
[우선 처치] When the Corrupted Warlock puts up its Dark Pact shield (30% of max health) at 50%, break it right away with Essence Break and single-target damage.
[차단] Kick one Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage with Disrupt, and if both are grouped, stop them together with Chaos Nova.
10: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel with Disrupt (Topicx).
[회피] Dodge Shivan Punisher's Whirlwind by Vengeful Retreating out of 12 yd.
[우선 처치] When the Punisher drops below 50%, use The Hunt to shorten the Demonic Frenzy damage window (Topicx).
11: [우선 처치] Felmaster Lucsei must die before its Blade Dance party AoE goes out more than three times (Topicx). Use Metamorphosis and The Hunt on Lucsei.

[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Lucsei's first Blade Dance (43642 Fire every 0.4 sec), and leave the next Blade Dance to group defensives. Step out of the group to dodge Lucsei's Eye Beam (frontal, 38793 Chaos).
13: [광역 피해] Pop Blur for Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to the whole group), and Fel Rush out of the nearby Defiled Detonation impacts (193965 Shadow within 5 yd).
[제어] Stop Felfire Burst from the 6 Unleashed Imps together with Chaos Nova. Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage with Disrupt.
[회피] Dodge the Golem's Fel Beam by walking backward (Topicx). If the beam corners you, Vengeful Retreat backward.
14: [제어] When the 6 Unleashed Imps are grouped, stop their Felfire Burst together with Chaos Nova.
[차단] Kick Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with Disrupt. If Chaos Nova went on the Imps, leave Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage to another kicker.
15: [위치] Pull Corrupted Warlock back and kill it first, then take Shivan Punisher separately (Topicx). Do not Fel Rush or Metamorphosis leap (40 yd) over to the Punisher.
[광역 피해] Pop Blur if you are the Drain Life target. Blur will not be back for the Punisher's Demonic Frenzy that follows, so take it with Deflecting Dance.
16: [광역 피해] Defiled Golem's AoE has to end within two casts, so stack Metamorphosis and The Hunt on the Golem (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Pop Blur for the first Defiled Slam and take the second with Deflecting Dance.
[차단] Kick Health Funnel from the 2 Fel Invokers with Disrupt, and dodge Fel Beam by walking backward toward the last boss (Topicx).

1: [광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust and cooldown pull (Topicx). Once the mobs are stacked, use Metamorphosis (2 min) and The Hunt (1 min 30 sec) together.
[해제] If you get the Insatiable Hunger curse from the Spirit of Hunger totem (stacking 15% max health reduction), press Immolation Aura to remove one curse from yourself with Soul Cleanse (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] Pop Blur (1 min) when Feast of Misery (38793 Shadow every sec for 5 sec) overlaps with the curse.
2: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) with Disrupt (15 sec). If it goes off, remove the Healing Breeze effect from the mobs with Consume Magic (10 sec) (Wowhead).
[해제] When Insatiable Hunger stacks, press Immolation Aura right away to remove your own curse with Soul Cleanse (Wowhead).
3: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Disrupt, and if Disrupt is on cooldown, stop it with Chaos Nova (45 sec, 3 sec stun). If it goes off, the pack does not die and the group falls apart (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery channel. If Blur from pull 2 is not back, line up Blade Dance and absorb up to 15% of your max health with Deflecting Dance.
4: [해제] Remove Spirit of Hunger's Insatiable Hunger by pressing Immolation Aura with Soul Cleanse (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] Pop Blur when Razor Dive bleeds from the 3 Keen-Eyed Strikers (33944 Physical every sec for 10 sec, stacking) build up on you and Feast of Misery overlaps.
5: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Disrupt. The tank drags this pack to the boss spot while the group clicks the barrels, so follow with Fel Rush and do not miss the cast.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss (Topicx). Use Metamorphosis (2 min) and The Hunt from pull 1 again on the pack gathered in the corner.
[제어] Kick one of the 2 Earthwhisper Tenders' Healing Breeze with Disrupt, and hold the other with Chaos Nova or Sigil of Misery (2 min, 15 sec disorient) (Wowhead).
[해제] Remove a Healing Breeze effect that went off with Consume Magic (Wowhead).
8: [우선 처치] Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward (shield plus 24246 Nature to the whole group every 2 sec) keeps hurting until the shield breaks, so put Essence Break (40 sec) and single-target damage into the Rumbler.
[참고] The 5 Frostfangs only hit the tank, so melt them together with Blade Dance and Immolation Aura.
9: [차단] Frigid Roar from the 2 Frigid Maulers (3.5 sec cast, 50% haste and movement speed reduction) cuts group damage and survivability hard, so spend Disrupt here first (Wowhead).
[회피] If Frigid Roar goes off, clear it with Vengeful Retreat (20 sec with Tactical Retreat) (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull (Topicx). Line up Metamorphosis and The Hunt with Bloodlust, and put Essence Break into the Terra Rumbler shield.
10: [차단] Frigid Roar from the 2 Frigid Maulers has a long cast and is easy to kick. Take one with Disrupt, and if both cast at once, stop them together with Chaos Nova (Topicx).
[회피] If Frigid Roar hits you, clear it with Vengeful Retreat (Wowhead).
[위치] Glacial Revenant's Cryo Surge also hits allies within 4 yd of the target, so Fel Rush away from the group if you are targeted.
11: [우선 처치] Kill Avatar of Determination first (Topicx). Charge it with The Hunt and put your cooldowns into the Avatar.
[회피] When the Avatar casts Pulverize (4 sec cast, 12 yd stun and 387930 Physical), leave 12 yd with Vengeful Retreat or Fel Rush, then come back with Felblade.
[위치] Stack with the group for Glacial Tomb and break the ice on the ally next to you as soon as you are free. Break the Terra Rumbler shield with Essence Break after the Avatar (Topicx).
13: [차단] Kick Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature, jumps to up to 3 targets) from the 2 Stormbound Mystics with Disrupt. A successful kick also gives Demon Muzzle, reducing magic damage taken by 15% for 12 sec.
[우선 처치] Break Ruthless Totemcaller's Magma Totem right away with Throw Glaive and single-target damage.
[광역 피해] Take Grizzled Warbringer's Primal Echo (stacking armor-ignoring Physical) with Blur on high keys (Topicx).
14: [우선 처치] Magma Totem from the 2 Ruthless Totemcallers (36368 Fire every 0.3 sec) overlaps with the casters' attacks, so break totems as soon as they appear (Topicx).
[차단] Kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Disrupt.
[참고] If the third Bloodlust goes out here, line up Metamorphosis and The Hunt. If it is saved for Loa Speaker Nanea on a high key, save Metamorphosis for Nanea too (Topicx).
15: [광역 피해] This is the largest trash pull of the route (85). The 4 Grizzled Warbringers take turns with Primal Echo, so alternate Blur and Deflecting Dance from Blade Dance (Topicx).
[차단] Take one of the 2 Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning with Disrupt, and if both are grouped, stop them together with Chaos Nova.
[우선 처치] Break Magma Totems from the 2 Ruthless Totemcallers right away.
16: [차단] Kick Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt with Disrupt.
[우선 처치] Break the 3 Volatile Totems first unless Nanea is around 10% health. Turn Eye Beam and Blade Dance onto the totems so they die by the second wave (Topicx).
[위치] If you are targeted by Earthquake, Fel Rush out of the group to drop the patch. If Bloodlust goes out here on a high key, line up Metamorphosis and The Hunt (Topicx).

1: [광역 피해] This pull takes the first hallway down to the Voidtouched Magi miniboss at once under Bloodlust (Topicx). Pop Metamorphosis (2 min) and charge the Magi with The Hunt (1 min 30 sec).

[차단] The tank takes the first kick on the Magi's Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow within 60 yd), so take the second kick with Disrupt (15 sec). A successful kick also gives Demon Muzzle, reducing magic damage taken by 15% for 12 sec (Topicx).
[회피] If you are the Null Eruption target (145474 Shadow within 10 yd and a 5 sec patch), Fel Rush out of the group to drop it and pop Blur (1 min) (Topicx).
2: [우선 처치] When Raj'kess the Spellstorm summons the 3 Orb of Disruption orbs, jump on them with Felblade (12 sec) and break them right away. If even one cast finishes, the group loses a lot of haste (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Pop Blur for the long Thundering Storm party AoE, and if Blur is down, line up Blade Dance to absorb up to 15% of your max health with Deflecting Dance (Topicx).
[위치] Forked Lightning (77586 Nature) jumps to 2 nearby players, so do not stand on top of other melee (Topicx).
3: [광역 피해] Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature every 2 sec for 10 sec) needs a personal defensive (Topicx). Pop Blur.
[우선 처치] When Brutok hits a wall and is stunned by Concussion for 5 sec, it also takes 20% more Physical damage, so put Essence Break (40 sec) and Metamorphosis (if back) into these 5 sec (Topicx).
[회피] If Angry Krolusk's Violent Sand hits you (155172 Nature to the group and 40% slow for 12 sec), clear the slow with Vengeful Retreat (20 sec with Tactical Retreat) (Wowhead).
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important kick in this area. Save Disrupt for the Screamer (Topicx).
[위치] Step into Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike circle (5 sec cast) together to split the damage, and leave the leftover swirl right after landing (Topicx).
[광역 피해] If you are the Void Beam target (43642 Shadow every 0.5 sec for 4 sec), Fel Rush out of the group and pop Blur (Topicx).
6: [우선 처치] Until Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams shield breaks, each slam raises party Physical damage by 10%. Stack Metamorphosis, The Hunt and Essence Break on the shield to break it fast (Topicx).
[참고] The Overseer must die before its next shield so it does not overlap with Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak (Topicx). If your cooldowns are down, keep single-target damage on the Overseer.
[광역 피해] When Macestorm (77586 Physical every sec for 6 sec within 8 yd) charges into melee, keep moving and pop Blur.
8: [우선 처치] When Devouring Brutalizer starts Devour (9 sec cast, heals 50%), switch to the marked low-health mob right away. Charge it with The Hunt and kill it before the cast ends (Topicx).
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Disrupt. Kick Voidminder's Mending Void only when the Devour target is dead and the Screamer is covered (Topicx).
[광역 피해] This is a damage cooldown pull (Topicx). Pop Metamorphosis, and pop Blur for Dreadbellow (knockback and 29095 Shadow every sec for 12 sec, cannot be dispelled).
9: [우선 처치] Switch to Devouring Brutalizer's Devour target right away. Melt the 10 Scavenging Siphoids together with Blade Dance and Immolation Aura (Topicx).
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Disrupt, and leave Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt to another kicker.
[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Dreadbellow. If Blur (1 min) from pull 8 is not back, line up Blade Dance and take it with Deflecting Dance.
10: [우선 처치] Chain-pull Watchful Harrower once Devouring Brutalizer is low enough to die before its next ability (Topicx). Hold The Hunt until the Harrower joins.
[위치] Step into Harrower's Sky Strike circle together to split it, and if you are the Void Beam target, Fel Rush out of the group (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Pop Blur when Dreadbellow overlaps with the Savage Leap bleed from Feral Saberon (38793 Physical every sec for 5 sec).

1: [해제] Remove Bound by Shadow (absorbs 122671 damage, 20% more damage done) from the Minion of Zul on the way with Consume Magic (10 sec). The mob dies the moment it is removed (Wowhead). It fears you when you get close, so you can also hold it with Chaos Nova (45 sec, 3 sec stun) before you reach it.

[광역 피해] This is the first pull of the dungeon and uses Bloodlust (Topicx), so line up Metamorphosis (2 min) and The Hunt (1 min 30 sec) once the 2 Animated Guardians and the Shadow-Borne Champion pack are gathered.

[광역 피해] Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow to the whole party) needs a personal defensive on every cast (Topicx). Pop Blur (1 min) for the first cast, and take the next one with Deflecting Dance by timing Blade Dance to the end of the cast.
2: [차단] Kick Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow and a 12 sec curse DoT) with Disrupt (15 sec). A successful kick gives Demon Muzzle, reducing magic damage taken by 15% for 12 sec, which also softens the next Shadow Whirlwind.
[해제] If the Hex Volley curse lands on you, press Immolation Aura to remove your own curse with Soul Cleanse, and clear the Shadowfrost Bolt effect with Vengeful Retreat (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] This corner pack is pulled on its own as a cooldown pull (Topicx), so put The Hunt and Essence Break (40 sec) into the Shadow-Borne Champion and pop Blur again for Shadow Whirlwind.
4: [차단] Kick Queen Wasi's Bind Soul (2.5 sec cast, 10 sec mind control) with Disrupt first. If Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending (7% heal every 2 sec for 10 sec) goes through, remove the heal with Consume Magic (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] The hardest group is King A'akul with the Bloodsworn Assassins (Topicx). If Metamorphosis is back, use it on this group, and pop Blur when bleeds stack on you.
[회피] If King Timalji's Bladestorm (2.5 sec cast, 164870 Physical every 0.5 sec) targets you, get far away with Fel Rush or Vengeful Retreat, then come back with Felblade (12 sec).
5: [광역 피해] Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole party) hurts a lot and needs party defensives (Topicx), so drop Darkness (5 min, 8 yd) where the party stands and pop Blur. If you use Bloodlust here on high keys, add Metamorphosis.
[회피] If Embalming Fluid's Putrid Seekers slows you by 20%, clear the slow with Vengeful Retreat and get out of the pool.
6: [차단] Take one of the two Wretched Discharge kicks (4 sec cast, 12 sec disease DoT on the whole party) from the 2 Half-Finished Mummies with Disrupt (Topicx). If both cast together, stun both with Chaos Nova. Havoc cannot dispel diseases.
7: [차단] Take one Half-Finished Mummy's Wretched Discharge with Disrupt, and stun both with Chaos Nova if the casts overlap.
[회피] Clear the Putrid Seekers slow from the 8 Embalming Fluids with Vengeful Retreat and get out of the pool.
9: [우선 처치] Kill the 2 Spectral Shamans first so no more Healing Tide Totems appear (Topicx). Put The Hunt and Essence Break into the shamans.

[제어] The 2 Phantom Hex Priests cast nonstop (Topicx), so kick Hex (3.5 sec cast, 5 sec polymorph) with Disrupt and stun them with Chaos Nova when they stand together. Without Chaos Nova, drop Sigil of Misery (2 min, 15 sec fear after 2 sec).
[광역 피해] Pop Blur when Royal Berserker's Bloodthirsty Axe (29095 Physical every sec, 12 sec bleed) stacks on you.
10: [광역 피해] On a 4-Bloodlust route the third Bloodlust goes on this bridge pack (Topicx), so line up Metamorphosis and The Hunt with the Ghostly Brute you kill first.

[회피] When you see Ghostly Brute's Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical nearby and a knock-up), vault out with Vengeful Retreat and come back with Felblade. Kick Phantom Hex Priest's Hex with Disrupt.
12: [해제] Remove Bound by Shadow from every Minion of Zul that Shadow of Zul calls with Consume Magic to kill it (Wowhead).
[위치] Shadow Barrage goes to whoever engages first (Topicx), so do not go in with Fel Rush or The Hunt before the tank.
[회피] If you are the Dark Revelation target (473120 Shadow within 20 yd after 5 sec), Fel Rush 20 yd away from the party and pop Blur.

1: [차단] The 2 Flashfrost Chillweavers' Ice Shield channel (15 sec, a shield every 3 sec plus crowd control immunity) must be kicked, so take one with Disrupt (15 sec).
[제어] When Tectonic Strike stacks from the 4 Deepstone Earthshapers get high on the tank, hold the Earthshapers with Chaos Nova (45 sec, 3 sec stun) so the stacks fall off (Topicx).

[우선 처치] The crowd-control-immune Primal Juggernaut dies first (Topicx), so line up Metamorphosis (2 min) and The Hunt (1 min 30 sec) on it, and pop Blur (1 min) for Excavating Blast (106681 Nature to the whole party and an 8 sec DoT).
2: [차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield channel with Disrupt.
[위치] Touching the eggs in the water spawns Infused Whelps that stack Cold Claws (Topicx). Do not Fel Rush or Vengeful Retreat toward the pools.
3: [제어] Stun the 2 Deepstone Earthshapers with Chaos Nova to break Tectonic Strike stacks, and kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Disrupt.

[우선 처치] Defier Draghar is immune to crowd control. Put The Hunt and Essence Break (40 sec) into Draghar, and since Blazing Rush is baited toward the wall (Topicx), do not stand on the side away from the wall in front of Draghar.
5: [차단] Spend Disrupt on Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt first, and break Ashseer Flamelasher's uninterruptible Flaming Barrage channel with Chaos Nova (Topicx).
[위치] If you are the Living Bomb target (6 yd explosion and knock-up after 6 sec), Fel Rush away from the party.
[회피] Pop Blur for Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno (Fire to the whole party plus a DoT), and when the Destroyer dies and Burnout goes off in 20 yd, vault out right away with Vengeful Retreat.
6: [광역 피해] Below 50% Flamegullet's Molten Blood keeps raising party damage (Topicx), so line up Metamorphosis and The Hunt just before 50% and kill it fast. On 17+ keys, Bloodlust goes at 50%.
[회피] If Flamegullet's Flame Breath (4 sec cast, frontal Fire) faces you, Fel Rush out of the cone.
[제어] Break Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Chaos Nova, and kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Disrupt.
7: [제어] Break both Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage with Chaos Nova, and kick Cinderbolt with Disrupt.
[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno, and vault 20 yd out of Burnout with Vengeful Retreat when the Destroyer dies.
8: [제어] Break Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Chaos Nova, and kick Cinderbolt with Disrupt.
[위치] Thunderhead patrols near this pack (Topicx), so do not Fel Rush toward it. After the kill, go past on the side without Thunderhead.
10: [광역 피해] This pull gathers 6 Storm Warriors, and the next pack is chained right after the Channeler dies (Topicx), so use Metamorphosis here if it is back.
[광역 피해] Pop Blur if you are the target of Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every sec).
[제어] Break Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Chaos Nova.
11: [차단] Kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Disrupt, and Fel Rush away from the party if you are the Living Bomb target.
[광역 피해] Pop Blur if you are the Lightning Torrent target. This stretch is chained without stopping (Topicx), so put The Hunt into the Tempest Channeler.
12: [광역 피해] While High Channeler Ryvati's Tempest Stormshield (shield of 20% max health) is up, the party takes Nature damage every sec, and if it expires with absorb left it stuns everyone within 60 yd for 4 sec. Stack Metamorphosis, The Hunt and Essence Break on the shield to break it fast (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Drop Darkness (5 min, 8 yd) where the party stands while the shield is up, and pop Blur if you are the Lightning Torrent target.
[해제] If Ryvati calls Primal Thunderclouds, remove their Stormcloud Barrier with Consume Magic (10 sec) (Wowhead).

1: [우선 처치] The crowd-control-immune Sandfury Stonefist dies first (Topicx), so line up Metamorphosis (2 min) and The Hunt (1 min 30 sec) on it.

[광역 피해] Pop Blur (1 min) for Ground Pound (4 sec cast, 156627 Physical within 60 yd and a knockback). A Storm Adept Lightning Bolt landing at the same time kills people (Topicx), so keep Disrupt (15 sec) available during the Ground Pound cast.
[제어] Break Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel) with Chaos Nova (45 sec, 3 sec stun).
2: [위치] The 2 Shrouded Fangs below the stairs are stealthed, and the tank must engage first (Topicx). Check their position with Spectral Sight (30 sec), and do not Fel Rush in before the tank.
[광역 피해] If Blur is down for Ground Pound, take it with Deflecting Dance by timing Blade Dance to the end of the cast, and put The Hunt into the Sandfury Stonefist.
4: [우선 처치] If Sand-Sworn Rider lives long, its Swarming Krolusks adds jump on far-away players (Topicx), so put The Hunt and Essence Break (40 sec) into the Rider.
[회피] About 5 sec after engage the Rider casts Scouring Sand (4.5 sec cast, frontal 290947 Nature and a 4 sec disorient) (Topicx). Do not stand in front of the Rider; hit it from the side or back.
[차단] Kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Disrupt, and break Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Chaos Nova.
5: [광역 피해] This big pull stacks 2 casters, Krolusk Matriarch and a Sand-Sworn Rider (Topicx). Line up Metamorphosis and The Hunt when the Rider is brought in.

[차단] A Lightning Bolt on someone already hit by a Krolusk charge or Cytotoxin kills them (Topicx), so kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Disrupt, and stop both with Chaos Nova if they cast together.
[광역 피해] Pop Blur when Barbed Krolusk's Serrated Charge bleed or Cytotoxin lands on you. Havoc cannot dispel poisons.
6: [차단] Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind is a 5 sec cast, so one kicker is enough (Topicx). Take it with Disrupt and leave Brood Tender's Venom Bolt to another kicker.
[우선 처치] Put The Hunt and Essence Break into the Sand-Sworn Rider to kill it fast.
7: [차단] Kick Brood Tender's Venom Bolt with Disrupt so it does not land on top of Cytotoxin (Topicx).
[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage and Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind together with Chaos Nova.
[광역 피해] Pop Blur when Cytotoxin (10 sec Nature DoT) from the 3 Poisonous Vipers stacks on you.
9: [차단] Do not let a kick slip while Agitated Nimbus's Release Charge (145474 Nature to the whole party) goes off (Topicx). Kick Imbued Stormcaller's Lightning Bolt with Disrupt.
[광역 피해] The two Nimbuses' Release Charges come staggered, so pop Blur for the first and take the next with Deflecting Dance by timing Blade Dance.

[회피] In the Loose Sparks stretch (290947 Nature and a 6 sec stun), do not Fel Rush between the orbs; walk around them. The orbs stop only when the Spark Channeler dies (Topicx), so put The Hunt into the Channeler.
10: [차단] This is a dangerous pull with a Nimbus, 2 casters and several Static Anomalies (Topicx). Stop both Imbued Stormcallers with Disrupt and Chaos Nova before the other mobs are gathered.
[광역 피해] For Release Charge, drop Darkness (5 min, 8 yd) where the party stands and pop Blur. If Metamorphosis is back, use it on this pull.
12: [차단] Temple Disruptor's Essence Disruption channel stops the orb from charging (Topicx), so kick the Disruptor on the tank's side with Disrupt.
[제어] The Disruptor on the other side is held with crowd control (Topicx). It is humanoid, so lock it with Imprison (45 sec, 1 min incapacitate) and do not hit it.
[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (116379 Nature within 60 yd and a 10 sec DoT).
13: [제어] Lock the far Temple Disruptor with Imprison, and kick the near Disruptor's Essence Disruption with Disrupt.
[광역 피해] Pop Blur for Caustic Stomp, and if Blur is on cooldown, take it with Deflecting Dance by timing Blade Dance.
14: [차단] The crowd-control-immune Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock (4 sec cast, 242456 Fire and an 8 sec DoT) must be kicked, so take it with Disrupt.

[제어] The 4 Faithless Tormentors chase only the healer and are held with slows and stuns (Topicx). Stun them with Chaos Nova first, then drop Sigil of Misery (2 min, 15 sec fear after 2 sec) when it ends.
[위치] If you get Latent Hex, Fel Rush 10 yd away from the party. Do not step into the Hex Muck it leaves when it ends.
